name: Haus Edith
beschreibung:
Located at the foot of Germany's and Austria's iconic border peak in Ehrwald, Haus Edith welcomes holidaymakers with cosy rooms and scenic mountain surroundings.

The Tiroler Zugspitzbahn cable car, the Ehrwalder Alm ski resort, and alpine walking trails are reached in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Edith in Ehrwald features warm hospitality and dramatic views of the Zugspitze massif.
